Turn arrows are individually draggable. MIL warning lights visible with borders/backgrounds. VTEC indicator appears when RPM >= 3000. Save/Reset/Cancel all work correctly.

PNG Gauge backgrounds: Speedometer uses 6 PNG images (spd-gauge.png, spd-medium-ticks.png, spd-large-ticks.png, spd-numbers.png, rpm-needle.png, rpm-needle-center.png)
RPM Readout separate widget: [data-testid='rpm-readout'] exists showing current RPM (e.g., '3192RPM')
RPM Readout draggable: [data-testid='editable-rpm-readout'] can be dragged independently (moved 100px right)
Individual left arrow: [data-testid='editable-turn-left'] exists and is independently draggable
Individual right arrow: [data-testid='editable-turn-right'] exists and stays in place when left arrow is dragged
Drag left arrow only: Left arrow moved 80px left, right arrow stayed in place (0px diff)
MIL Warning Lights visible: All 7 warnings visible at bottom with borders (1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) and padding (8px 12px)
Warning lights individually draggable: CHECK ENGINE moved 80px up, LOW FUEL stayed in place
VTEC indicator: Red 'VTEC' text visible inside tachometer when RPM >= 3000
Tachometer drag: Moved 50px left independently, speedometer stayed in place (0px diff)
Cancel button: Reverts changes correctly (position returned to initial)
Reset button: Returns to default layout
Save & Exit: Persists layout through page reload (2px diff after reload)

features_verified.details: Both tachometer and speedometer use PNG image-based gauges from /assets/gauges/. Dark design with chrome rim visible.
RPM readout is a standalone widget [data-testid='rpm-readout'] showing current RPM number. Wrapped in [data-testid='editable-rpm-readout'] for independent dragging.
Left arrow [data-testid='editable-turn-left'] and right arrow [data-testid='editable-turn-right'] are separately wrapped and independently draggable.
All 7 warning lights visible at bottom with rgba(255,255,255,0.04) background and rgba(255,255,255,0.08) border when inactive. Icon color #71717a when inactive.
Red 'VTEC' text appears inside tachometer gauge face when RPM >= 3000. Uses animate-pulse and red text-shadow.
All widgets (tachometer, speedometer, RPM readout, turn arrows, warning lights) can be dragged independently without affecting others.
Save persists layout through reload. Reset returns to default. Cancel reverts session changes.
